field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: List current executable identities; no LLM is intended in this task.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Record expected, observed, and passed while separating completion from value.
field_principles.amortization: Separate setup, per-request savings, and supported whole-path bounds.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure actual monotonic elapsed time without a padded floor.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use host; retained board receipts do not imply current board execution.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain fields without wrapping executable scores or ordinary dictionaries.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked result points to upstream, failed check, field, expected, and observed.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_ and names the check.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declare deterministic CPU evaluator work, not cited historical model work.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the closed duration class exercised by current computation.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed, failed, cancelled, and in-flight work.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any real model load or generation attempt, including a failed attempt.
field_principles.native_cost_complete_score: One requires all ninety paired blocks, complete costs, and parity.
field_principles.native_ten_x_score: One requires the unchanged ten-x lower-bound gate at every size.
field_principles.phase_spans: Use disjoint spans, completed units, checkpoints, and pending operations.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Name input identity, availability, and each failed check before work.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development, evaluation, and resampling seeds before outcomes.
field_principles.repository_health: Keep unrelated dated failures separate from affected required checks.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, settings, inputs, evaluator identity, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Retain every size, seed, arm, repetition count, complete time, and parity result.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260916 and retain actual UTC timestamps.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed, censored, and the fixed stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact while preserving ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate exact producers, current sources, and task-owned raw rows.
field_principles.status: Publish a terminal result only after current work and affected validation.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain exact command, scope, exit, duration, and log hash, including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use only positive, circular_positive, null, blocked, disqualified, or partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: The shared execution authority defines correctness, so circularity remains explicit.
